statement: At a retained node,earned interacting base mu has bounded featureZ,||Z||<=R,and paid sampler for EVERY q_v proportional exp(-v dot Z)mu with trace covariance<=V,operator covariance<=K. Convex f with1-Lipschitz gradient gives exact target pi proportional exp(-f(Z))mu by tangent rejection q_gradf(a),accept exp(-D_f(Z,a)) for ANY anchor. Dual F(v)=f*(v)+psi(-v) has unique minimizer v*=grad f(m*),m*=E_qv* Z;exact anchor acceptance>=exp(-V/2). Sampled proximal steps tau=1/(1+K) are finite via Moreau/inner strongly convex optimization,not free prox oracle. Actual implementation uses batch b=288V(1+K)^3,rounded R_init=R+1,explicit tolerances and final anchor good probability>=31/36. Smooth finite acceptance floor is exp[-(V+1)/2-1],with certified support-wise affine minorant/intercept cushion. For exact tangent logZ_f=psi(-v)+v dot a-f(a)+logA;for ACTUAL certified minorant v dot Z+c use psi(-v)-c+logA. Every successful restart retains the same target. Joint negative/observation budget V<=[p beta TrN+L||Bobs||F^2]/(1-alpha_p);pMdelta=p beta removes mesh from exponent,NOT arithmetic/storage/sampling. Posterior covariance/mixing is not inherited;every solve uses the original all-tilt base.
